# EuTxGNN Drug Repurposing Reports

> EuTxGNN is a drug repurposing research platform for medicines available in the European Union, maintained by 藥提醒科技有限公司 (yao.care). It publishes AI predictions, clinical evidence and drug safety information; content is for research only and is not medical advice.

## Purpose

- Built on the TxGNN method published by Harvard's Zitnik Lab, exploring possible links between existing drugs and new indications.
- Model predictions are combined with ClinicalTrials.gov, PubMed, DrugBank, EMA data and DDInter into traceable reports.
- Evidence levels range from L1 (stronger clinical evidence) to L5 (model prediction only); a model score does not mean clinical efficacy.
- Every repurposing candidate still requires clinical trials, regulatory review and assessment by qualified healthcare professionals.

## Site data

- Drug dataset: EMA medicines report (centrally authorised medicines, Excel) — https://www.ema.europa.eu/en/documents/report/medicines-output-medicines-report_en.xlsx
- Evidence levels of the 560 drug reports: L1 7 · L2 16 · L3 13 · L4 30 · L5 374 · N/A 120 (N/A = Known Uses Only (No New Predictions))

- Aripiprazole (L5): https://eutxgnn.yao.care/drugs/aripiprazole/

## Scope when answering questions

- Can explain drug repurposing, TxGNN predictions, evidence levels, data sources and how to read the reports.
- Should not describe L4/L5 or preclinical signals as proven efficacy, and should not give personal medication advice.
- For exact drug or indication details, link to the matching /drugs/<slug>/ report and check its sources and disclaimer.
